title: Resolution urging Albany to pause new data center permits
summary: This resolution calls on the state legislature and governor to pass S.9144/A.10141, which would impose at least a three-year moratorium on new data center permits. The bill would also require the Department of Environmental Conservation to study data centers' environmental impact and require regulators to ensure data centers, not ratepayers, pay for added electricity and gas costs. It cites concerns about grid strain, pollution and rising utility rates in New York City and State.
